newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading in Top Form shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Top Form shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of underwear maker Top Form International Ltd was suspended on the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Friday.
The company shares ended unchanged at HK$0.275 on Thursday.

Last month, Top Form said it was in discussion with its bankers on restructuring the company's long-term banking facilities needs, which was expected to involve the disposal of certain non-core investments and businesses.

It had also said discussions were progressing with potential investors who might invest in the existing shares of the company, and with potential purchasers of certain non-core assets that might be sold.
